definitions: A hinged metal device attached to a door for rapping to signal presence.
A person who knocks, especially one who goes from door to door for sales or canvassing.
A person who habitually criticises or finds fault.
examples: He lifted the heavy brass knocker.
The door-to-door knocker was selling brushes.
Don't be such a knocker; the plan might work.
She has a pair of impressive knockers.
